alignment.estimation_method: timestamp_anchored: align on documented acquisition start markers / recorded timestamps only; if absent, a single frozen cross-correlation of the belt band-limited signal against the radar range-bin band-limited signal over the WHOLE recording (not per-window, not per-candidate)

quality_checks: residual timing uncertainty reported and folded into error tolerance
crucial_rule: Alignment may use acquisition timing and permitted signal-independent markers, but MUST NOT be selected to minimize radar estimator error. If waveform-based alignment is required, exactly ONE fixed method is preregistered here and its residual uncertainty is added to the error tolerance.
